comparison.objective: Press a copper tube into two self-closing clamps until both double-click and lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a long tube across two mouths and apply balanced insertion force through two detents.
comparison.success_condition: Both clamps reach their second click around a straight, seated tube; tube is still and grippers clear.
comparison.reason: This is force-controlled multi-point insertion and latching, not impact-mediated material separation and containment.
